title: Downloads extension
notes: A new free Downloads extension is in the Marketplace — a downloads directory with categories, GitHub-release / URL links or private file uploads, and per-download counts. Category icons can be a preset emoji or your own uploaded image. Plus embedded extension management panels in the admin area now follow light/dark instantly.

changelog.text: The free Downloads extension is now in the Marketplace — organise downloads into categories, link a GitHub release or URL, or upload a file served through a private counted route. Cards show a cover, a short excerpt and per-download counts.
Category icons can be a preset emoji or your own uploaded image.
Embedded extension management panels in the admin area now follow the light/dark theme immediately instead of only after a refresh.
